notes.title: New languages are available - Japanese and Chinese! And gamepad updates in 1.0.7
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Exciting news!
New languages are available - Japanese and Chinese! And full support of dualshock and xbox gamepad in the new version of Listeria Wars!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36073259/14d2c0ceae88385ba79e3de808bddcaa18e6b10d.png[/img]

ːsteamthisː Important info!
I would like to ask for your help. I need to improve the quality of Japanese and Chinese, I don't have budget for professional localization, so it's not perfect. Could you please post all fixes, edits and improvements to Japanese and Chinese in the general discussions? I've created a thread for that [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1183010/discussions/0/6367585250004343453/]here[/url]

What's new in 1.0.7?
[list]
[*] Japanese language
[*] Chinese language
[*] Full Dualshock / PS4 gamepad support
[*] Improved Xbox controller support
[*] Added volume and sound sliders
[*] Added ability to change cursor speed for gamepads
[*] Huge balance improvements (it will never get done)
[*] Fixed some text layouts
[*] Fixed cursor disappearing when dualshock is connected
[*] Little fixes and improvements
[/list]

Thank you for your feedback and advices!
I hope I made the game better and will definitely continue to improve it.

notes.title: Listeria Wars, Linux and MacOS versions
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Exciting news!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36073259/3622494179b7ed823059302eda5248c6499be304.png[/img]

I am thrilled to announce that I have expanded the availability of the Listeria Wars to include Linux and MacOS versions!

Both Linux and MacOS versions of my game have been carefully optimized to ensure smooth performance and compatibility, allowing players to fully enjoy the Listeria Wars without any technical hiccups. 
I've made significant improvements to the Windows version too.

What's new in 1.0.5?
[list]
[*] Balance improvements: unit upgrades, levels, enemy parameters
[*] Gamepad improvements
[*] Saving bug was fixed
[*] In-game settings were fixed
[*] Popup fix
[*] Cursor speed fix
[*] Small fixes and improvements
[/list]
New languages on the way!

Thank you for your feedback and advices!
I hope I made the game better and will definitely continue to improve it.

notes.title: Listeria Wars — Update 1.0.4. Cost is reduced!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36073259/4fe95408a14906071d4dc73478fe81fbbf67f6f7.png[/img]
I have come to the realization that I had initially set an excessively high price for the game. After conducting a thorough analysis, I have made adjustments to ensure that the price is in line with the current market standards.

Furthermore, several issues were identified and have been rectified.

What's new in 1.0.4?
[list]
[*] Replaced immune system cell videos by gifs due to problems with some devices and platforms
[*] Fixed bug that displayed cell video in popups while it isn't needed
[*] Optimized shaders for better performance
[*] Fixed xbox gamepad detection
[*] Fixed issues with submitting achievements after offline playing
[*] Fixed menu double clicks while clicking once
[*] Balance has been improved and fixed bug that add mana (sc) while palying intro videos
[*] Fixed bug that didn't hide cursor while using gamepad
[*] Moved to new unity version and added little improvements
[/list]

Mac/Linux versions on the way!

Thank you for your feedback and advices!
I hope I made the game better and will definitely continue to improve it.

notes.title: Listeria Wars has been updated to include achievements!
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce that Listeria Wars now has Achievements! There are now more than 20 Achievements. Some are designed to test your skill and knowledge of the game, while others are designed to be fun!
